criteria.description: Home presents Dana's identity, contact actions, route navigation, and the black wave.
criteria.evidence: npm test: home public actions and visible non-intercepting wave passed; phone and desktop captures visually approved.

criteria.description: Home navigation reflows without horizontal scrolling at narrow widths.
criteria.evidence: npm test: home overflow assertions passed at 320, 360, 390, 412, 768, 844-by-390, and 1440 pixels.

criteria.description: Primary navigation and content actions meet the 44-by-44-pixel target minimum.
criteria.evidence: npm test: every primary action has a 44 by 44 pixel target passed.

criteria.description: Wave adapts to portrait and landscape without obscuring essential content.
criteria.evidence: Playwright wave-safety test passed; final 320, 768, 844-by-390, and 1440 viewport captures were visually inspected.

criteria.description: Wave honors reduced motion and pauses when the page is hidden.
criteria.evidence: npm test: reduced-motion still wave and hidden-document pause/resume assertions passed.

criteria.description: Services presents the current offering with actionable phone and email links.
criteria.evidence: npm run validate and npm test: Services content plus exact tel and mailto destinations passed.

criteria.description: Portfolio presents Vanity PermitOps, Dana's contribution, technology context, and the project action.
criteria.evidence: npm run validate and npm test: Portfolio required content and https://permitops.com destination passed.

criteria.description: Resume supplies readable mobile HTML plus View PDF and Download PDF actions.
criteria.evidence: npm test: mobile resume headings, 16-pixel essential text, and exact PDF actions passed; resume.pdf is 78,389 bytes.

criteria.description: Resume remains useful without the optional large-screen PDF embed.
criteria.evidence: npm test: mobile embed hidden, desktop preview visible, and essential no-script content passed.

criteria.description: Every inner page provides a consistent touch-friendly route back home.
criteria.evidence: npm run validate and npm test: route controls exist, meet target size, and expose visible keyboard focus.

criteria.description: Animated duplicate labels expose one understandable accessible name.
criteria.evidence: npm test: exact accessible-name assertions passed for all primary route actions.

criteria.description: Browser titles and descriptions identify Dana and the portfolio accurately.
criteria.evidence: npm run validate: title and description metadata passed for all four routes.

criteria.description: Every tested route is free of horizontal overflow from 320 through 1440 pixels.
criteria.evidence: npm test: 28 route-and-viewport overflow checks passed.

criteria.description: Essential phone content renders at 16 pixels or larger.
criteria.evidence: npm test: mobile resume essential text-size assertion passed.

criteria.description: Production structural validation completes before handoff.
criteria.evidence: npm ci, npm run build, and npm audit --audit-level=high passed from the final lane.

criteria.description: Mobile performance and accessibility score at least 90 on every route.
criteria.evidence: Local mobile Lighthouse audits scored 100 performance and 100 accessibility on home, services, portfolio, and resume.

criteria.description: Essential navigation and content remain usable without JavaScript or wave initialization.
criteria.evidence: npm test: essential content remains when scripting is unavailable passed; wave failure preserves fallback content.

criteria.description: The site remains usable at 200-percent text sizing and by keyboard.
criteria.evidence: npm test: 200-percent text reflow and visible keyboard-focus assertions passed.
